none: PAS HESH-7E4D13: Roman Coin: Radiate of Gallienus
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ GALLIENVS AVG ; R/ [IO]VI CONS AVG

A copper-alloy Roman radiate of Gallienus (AD 253-268), sole reign, dating to the period AD 260-268 (Reece period 13). Obverse description:Radiate bust, right. Obverse inscription: GALLIENVS AVG. Reverse description: Goat walking left. Reverse inscription: [IO]VI CONS AVG. Die axis measurement: 6 o'clock. Weight: 2.4g. Diameter: 20.2mm. Mint of Rome. As Cunetio no. 1368; RIC V.2, no. 207
